content: We leverage unlabeled documents differently for different pre-training tasks (see Section SECREF9). We first split each document into 512 token segments if it contains more than 512 tokens (segments or documents with less than 512 tokens are removed). In Sentence Reordering (SR) and Masked Document Generation (MDG), we use the segment after transformation to predict the original segment. We set the minimum masked length $a=100$ and the maximum masked length $b=256$ in MDG. In Next Sentence Generation (NSG), each segment is used to predict its next 256 tokens.
